answer_1.quote: Reward Models (RMs) are used to guide the LLM (i.e., policy) training by scoring generated responses.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate our trained models using RewardBench , which contains ∼3k assorted tasks from 23 different datasets. Each task consists of a binary preference sample and is categorized into one of the following four categories: Chat, Chat-Hard, Safety, and Reasoning. We report the accuracy for each category and an overall score by averaging the accuracies.

answer_4.quote: we gather 3 annotations from different annotators and use a majority vote to determine the final preference. All annotators were senior Computer Science PhD students specializing in NLP with extensive experience working with and evaluating LLMs.
